caption: The drawing shows a four-wheeled carriage, resembling a baby stroller or early pram, with distinct features. The body of the carriage is green with curved, decorative gold lines on the side. The seat is black, with a matching black canopy covering the top, which appears to be made of a textured or fabric-like material. The frame and wheels are rendered in shades of beige and tan, with each wheel consisting of multiple spokes, and the rear wheels are larger than the front ones. Two yellowish, wooden push handles are attached at the back. The carriage is positioned slightly sideways, displaying its right side with all four wheels visible. The background is plain and off-white, allowing the carriage to be the central and only detailed object in the drawing.
title: Doll Carriage
